# CS2Prac item docs

Data: ByMykel/CSGO-API skin data and the game's weapons.vdata, 2026-11-18. Searchable with pictures: [the item site](https://projectgloria.github.io/CS2Prac/).

What every item the K window and the Loadout tab offer is: rarity, collection, wear range and weapon stats. In game, `!info` prints the same for the item in your hand; in the app, right-click a tile (or its (i) button).
